Checkpoint 1 revisions: before and after

Every pose of each revised structure. In each cell: solid silhouette and shaded sprite at 6× nearest-neighbour, then the shaded sprite at 32 and 48 CSS pixels (gameplay sizes). Same neutral palette, the game's own shading and outline. Native 16×16.

Long-limbed upright

Narrow torso, elongated arms and legs, taller outline. Closest other structure (neutral silhouettes, mirror included): before perching_avian 0.83, after plant_bodied 0.73.
